cause_quote: The new composer view set data-composer-layout={props.mobileComposer && !mobileEditing() ? "single-line" : undefined}, collapsing the composer whenever the pane supplied mobile presentation, with CSS noting it applies "independently of width".
user_saw: In browser windows between about 641 and 900 px wide (drawer navigation), the empty chat composer collapsed to one line and hid its toolbar controls.
summary: Gates the one-line resting composer on a phone-width media query so wider drawer-navigation windows keep the expanded editor and toolbar.
reasoning: The one-line resting composer was introduced in 1bc029e59c6 keyed only on mobileComposer, and the stacked feature 1894bb9b0a5 (#176653, ten minutes later) wired it as mobileComposer: Boolean(mobileHost), which is true for the whole drawer-nav range (MOBILE_NAV_MAX_WIDTH 900, unchanged since before the graft). composer-mobile.css never had a width media gate in its history, and later commits (4c1855035ed mobileResting) only refined the same condition, so wide drawer windows collapsed from the start; cause is the feature pair, medium because the defect needs both commits.
